summary: Proof of concept on the rollo toy set with the BatchNorm MLP encoder, 30 seeds, rules pre-registered before each run (Notebooks/PoC_Hypotheses_Rollo.ipynb, run 3). Task-level adaptation is supported; attention with consensus down-weights artifact-like contamination; the local term (K2) shows no gain and the K3 ladder is ordered as expected but not significant. EEG experiments have not run.

metrics.name: target-domain accuracy
metrics.why: Decides the task-level and K3 contrasts.

metrics.name: attention-mass contrast c
metrics.why: Reads whether attention down-weights contaminated windows (K1).

metrics.name: partner separation s
metrics.why: Reads whether the local term pairs compatible bags (K2).

hypotheses.statement: Contaminated windows receive less attention weight than clean ones, more so than without consensus.
hypotheses.metric: attention-mass contrast c on contaminated vs clean windows
hypotheses.criterion: pre-registered rule: every contrast of the family with (Holm-adjusted) p < 0.05
hypotheses.rationale: Validated with artifact contamination (off-manifold, as EEG artifacts); fails at 10% donor-class contamination.

hypotheses.statement: The local term aligns each target bag with its compatible source partner beyond the global term.
hypotheses.criterion: pre-registered rule: every contrast of the family with (Holm-adjusted) p < 0.05
hypotheses.observed: K2a: s(TGL) > 0: p_Holm = 1.86e-09; K2b: s(TGL) > s(TG): p_Holm = 8.20e-01. Mean separation TGL 0.0520, TG 0.0566; partner mass TGL 0.063 (chance 0.056).
hypotheses.rationale: The local term adds nothing over global-only on the toy set, even with 4 source bags per class and a smooth subject shift.

hypotheses.statement: Both adaptation terms together beat each alone, and the consensus beats its no-consensus variant.
hypotheses.criterion: pre-registered rule: every contrast of the family with (Holm-adjusted) p < 0.05
hypotheses.observed: K3a: TGL > TGL-NC: mean diff +0.035, HL +0.028, p_Holm = 2.38e-01; K3b: TGL > TG: mean diff +0.006, HL +0.000, p_Holm = 3.70e-01; K3c: TGL > TL: mean diff +0.027, HL +0.019, p_Holm = 2.53e-01. Means: TGL-NC 0.813, TG 0.843, TL 0.822, TGL 0.848. | artifact ladder: K3a [artifact]: TGL > TGL-NC: mean diff +0.011, HL +0.009, p_Holm = 4.71e-01; K3b [artifact]: TGL > TG: mean diff +0.002, HL +0.000, p_Holm = 4.71e-01; K3c [artifact]: TGL > TL: mean diff +0.025, HL +0.019, p_Holm = 2.42e-01. Means: TGL-NC 0.809, TG 0.817, TL 0.795, TGL 0.820.
hypotheses.rationale: Gaps go in the expected direction (TGL 0.848 > TG 0.843 > TL 0.822 > TGL-NC 0.813) but none is significant.

qualitative.title: Attention under artifact contamination
qualitative.reading: Artifacts receive less weight than clean windows at every rate.

limitations: Toy-set evidence only; no EEG campaign has run.
Comparators are not part of the PoC, so ranking claims are untested here.
next_steps: Discuss K2 and K3 before the full EEG run.
Place the full run with the timing probe and plan before launching.

novelty.claim: Unsupervised bag-level adaptation of subject-level EEG diagnosis to unlabeled target bags (relevance- and consensus-weighted bag kernel, class-conditional Rényi global alignment, subject-level local alignment).
novelty.rationale: The novelty comparison is against the eight comparators on EEG, which runs only in the full experiments; the PoC supports adaptation over the source-only floor on the toy set.
